national_news.title: FM Nirmala Sitharaman Addresses 5th Kautilya Economic Conclave on Economic Resilience and Reforms
bullets: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addressed the 5th Kautilya Economic Conclave in New Delhi, highlighting fiscal prudence, GST, Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), and labor codes as core drivers of growth.
Citing IMF projections, she stated that India's general government debt is projected to decline from 83.4% of GDP in 2026 to 77.7% in 2031.

Key statistics shared include a budgeted capital expenditure of ₹12.22 lakh crore for the current fiscal, a 61% expansion in the national highway network since 2014, and over 52 crore loans sanctioned under PM MUDRA Yojana.

national_news.title: India Secures Multiple Gold Medals at Asian Games, Climbs to Fourth Rank Overall
bullets: The Indian Men's Hockey team defended their Asian Games gold medal by defeating Malaysia 5-1, securing a direct qualification berth for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

Pranavi Urs became the first Indian woman to win an Asian Games gold medal in the individual golf event, alongside gold wins in T20 Men's Cricket, Archery (Kumkum Mohod), and Wrestling (Aman Sehrawat).
India climbed to 4th place in the overall standings with a total medal tally of 85, including 21 gold, 27 silver, and 37 bronze medals.
